title: Scalar Curvature Question [?68]: Let $\widetilde X$ be the universal cover of a Riemannian $n$-manifold $X$ homeomorphic to the $n$-torus
exact_target: Can the universal cover of any Riemannian torus be exhausted by domains mapping with degree one to a cube, with positive face mean curvature and no dihedral angle larger than a right angle?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 6700064 (AMR-066-0064). CC BY 4.0.
Misha Gromov, \emph{Four Lectures on Scalar Curvature}, arXiv:1908.10612v6 (9 July 2021), \S3.13, Exercise and full hint, printed p. 168; corner-map definitions in \S3.18, printed p. 186.
